meta.name: deployment-pipeline-design
meta.description: Design multi-stage CI/CD pipelines with approval gates, security checks, and deployment orchestration. Use this skill when designing zero-downtime deployment pipelines, implementing canary rollout strategies, setting up multi-environment promotion workflows, or debugging failed deployment gates in CI/CD.

copy.tagline: 设计可回滚、带安全审批的发布流水线
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的团队需要规划安全、零停机的软件发布流程
copy.tagline_en: Design gated, rollback-ready release pipelines for zero-downtime deployment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs to design secure, zero-downtime multi-environment release workflows

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你设计多阶段 CI/CD 流水线:定义阶段与作业依赖,选定金丝雀或蓝绿等发布方式,配置健康检查、审批关卡和回滚方案。
howto.when: 当你要为新服务设计 CI/CD 架构、在多环境间配置审批与安全扫描关卡,或排查流水线闸门失败时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一条带审批关卡的金丝雀发布流水线
say.note: 会给出阶段划分、金丝雀权重和关卡配置

say.text: staging 通过了但生产任务一直不启动,帮我排查
say.note: 会检查生产环境保护规则与审批人设置

say.text: 回滚后数据库迁移还留着,怎么设计兼容的迁移
say.note: 会建议只增不改的迁移与 undo 脚本

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude designs multi-stage CI/CD pipelines: stage definitions and job dependencies, a rollout strategy (canary or blue-green), health checks, approval gates, and a rollback plan.
howto.when_en: Use it when designing CI/CD architecture for a new service, setting up multi-environment promotion with approval and security gates, or debugging failed pipeline gates.

say_en.text: Design a canary deployment pipeline with approval gates
say_en.note: Gives stage layout, canary weights, gate config

say_en.text: Staging passed but the production job never starts — help me debug
say_en.note: Checks environment protection rules and reviewers

say_en.text: Rollback left DB migrations applied — how to design compatible ones?
say_en.note: Suggests additive migrations with versioned undo scripts
